descriptions.d30d_message_service_ctor_8016169c: Message service constructor: base constructor, vtable, global self pointer, reads MRS.MaxMessages and MRS.MaxInterests with defaults 500 and 4096, allocates the table, the pool of 20-byte records, and four arrays of three-word lists with a count cookie, clears the table, resizes the free pool vector at 0x80455244 to the interest count and points each element at its pool record. Returns this.
